sourceLabel: SYNTHETIC SAMPLE - invented for offline preview and tests; NOT exchange data, NOT a market-data feed
notLiveStatement: This is NOT live market data. These quotes are invented sample numbers with no relation to any real price; they say nothing about value, direction or tradability.
note: NIFTY 24500 CE has a quote. SENSEX 80000 PE (in the reference) deliberately has none. The BANKNIFTY quote belongs to a contract that is AMBIGUOUS in the reference, and the NIFTY 24600 CE quote to a contract that is NOT in it: both exist to prove that premium data is never looked up unless the contract is FOUND.
